entries.acceptance: On daily failure roll two dice minus four injury separately for every affected traveler and route it through the common injury system; define nonpositive results explicitly.
Use -3 within land and -4 within water, with only coast/lagoon and swamp/river bridging at -4. Cross-planet defaults add -4 only for matching world types.
Require explicit optional definitions for extreme constructed terrain; do not grant defaults not provided by the campaign.
Resolve terrain-feature searches only when a feature exists and use strength/dexterity/health substitutions for eligible tasks. Distinguish improvised, commercial and large-pit trap setup times.
Use the higher health or skill for aquatic exertion and injury avoidance, opposed swimming for equal-speed races and separate rescue procedures; high diving is a sport.
Require a tradition and the chosen focus-versus-inherent-symbol model; nontraditional tools or surfaces impose authored penalties.
Default to matching ritual magic at -4, roll before the ritual and consume the rounded-down half-margin bonus on the next eligible ritual only.
Use the lower inscription and enchantment scores with no ordinary default; separate alphabets retain separate investment. External-supplement systems are out of scope.
Resolve authored small-unit deployment or opposed leadership plans; personal precombat advantage requires preparation. Use the better tactics or perception for surprise detection.
Require level twelve for teacher qualification and apply both participants language penalties, plus relevant social-trait penalties; integrate with study eligibility.
Require animal-type specialization with -3 cross-defaults and handling first for difficult teams. Check daily ordinarily or every ten seconds for galloping or combat maneuvers.
Critical failures and any galloping failure spill the vehicle: resolve five-yard falls for each passenger/animal, individual broken-leg checks, calming and authored reload time.
Apply penalties for more than four animals, unfamiliar teams and difficult terrain; galloping begins at eighty percent of full animal movement.
Add owned magical aptitude to learning, use the invention procedure for spell research and author evidence from observed magic; applying theory to other magical traditions is penalized.
Require a religion, with only explicit related-tradition defaults. Studying doctrine does not impose belief; moral guidance must follow authored doctrine.
Provide the comparative specialty and -5 defaults into religions normally studied in the setting; preserve professional ritual prerequisites.
Limit ordinary throwing to suitable small objects, apply trained distance strength bonuses without damage bonuses and allow untrained area throws at full dexterity.
Require cinematic martial permission; allow only liftable objects, apply the distinct distance/damage thresholds and replace rather than stack weapon-mastery damage.
Map the five printed improvised-object categories to their specified attack statistics without granting every improvised object the same damage.
Validate the matching balanced/tethered/projectile form and use its equipment statistics; do not infer cross-specialty defaults beyond those printed.
Validate the matching balanced/tethered/projectile form and use its equipment statistics; do not infer cross-specialty defaults beyond those printed.
Validate the matching balanced/tethered/projectile form and use its equipment statistics; do not infer cross-specialty defaults beyond those printed.

Validate the matching balanced/tethered/projectile form and use its equipment statistics; do not infer cross-specialty defaults beyond those printed.
Allow the darts game specialty to default to thrown-dart skill without a penalty; retain its distinct game-rules scope.
Check to acquire the trail and at terrain-dependent intervals; apply trail age, subject group and appropriate sensory modifiers.
Use 1800 seconds between required continuation checks with modifier 0, preserving partial progress and preventing extra boundary rolls.
Use 900 seconds between required continuation checks with modifier -2, preserving partial progress and preventing extra boundary rolls.
Use 300 seconds between required continuation checks with modifier -4, preserving partial progress and preventing extra boundary rolls.
Use 60 seconds between required continuation checks with modifier -6, preserving partial progress and preventing extra boundary rolls.
Doubling travel time can conceal tracks on success; require an invested tracker to follow and replace continuation rolls with contests against the concealer.
Distinguish detection, disarming, resetting and construction; detection uses perception and vision bonuses, while other operations have their own difficulty and equipment context.
Use three words per skill point for manual machines and five for electric/computer input; accept only explicitly eligible typing-intensive defaults.
Resolve authored urban physical shelter, access, water and hazard information; social underworld navigation remains separate.
Resolve a short-range authored voice deception with distraction and suspicious-audience modifiers.
Care for an animal with trust and unfamiliar-type modifiers; optional animal specialization must remain compatible with treatment and recovery ownership.
entries.validation_note: Typed no-IQ-default veterinary skill implements paid animal-handling and same-TL medical defaults. Explicit animal context applies trust and unfamiliarity modifiers, and accepts matching approved optional specialties. Animal treatment/recovery ownership integration remains pending. Fixtures unrun.

entries.acceptance: Require the authored speculative-technology context; successful invention support gives +5 or +1 with the invention trait, while investigation gives +2 and only explicit permission for unusual defaults.
Use the better dexterity or skill for grappling/takedowns and apply relative-training strength benefits only to listed operations. Require both hands for one parry and retain weapon penalties.
Produce authored readable work with time, language and unfamiliar-subject modifiers.
Require martial permission, bow eighteen and meditation. On success divide the combined size and speed/range penalties by three with the specified rounding; apply concentration-time modifiers.

exclusions.reason: Source fiction, named character builds, illustrative wording and art are excluded. Alphabetical redirects refer to earlier definitions; external supplements mentioned by the source remain outside scope.
